data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=20e1pVcWi5EQ7kNvgElx0Cz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCm2B_mScxrhWD3OPhmkQ-s6Dw9xwkcpzxj3nXCH9OYtw&oe=67260D9C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=vnILX01tvY4Q7kNvgHRM9Gp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB_43y5EeORhLLNwzwTILYDGl910gWUn2pES-v9ji7o5A&oe=67261724)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T4QYzO2EDLoQ7kNvgG6zy0Y&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAWuwIBXW6cDj0bG99_ZecEVGf3mM7jC8A7voflVdDg_w&oe=6725FE87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=w4aOlYv7mtQQ7kNvgGBQYpZ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAtrcvWrxEsuJ8sfmnd9qfwc6HziXaZl7HHzQ5F-IwySg&oe=6725F166)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lC-DjG0xWV4Q7kNvgGekReG&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAl9hTteUPdP1y5tDJLm3cxm6DPIpa4dZIuAP8tuSR55A&oe=67261DD8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=BmK6MAUFp-cQ7kNvgGbBny7&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDz24HnoyU9EB741tOXyKmfIfttWVLen299cVsZRB1Ghw&oe=67261A59)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=8as5YNsSrskQ7kNvgEoJchF&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCma2ctLwqZ9x0Qs17v9NXgHl8y9WQBIk-kELL_dTpyAQ&oe=67260070)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=4ouaazwEsX8Q7kNvgELYHcq&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCPPZOCGPzAm6y39j9KSUoPL9bDJn2L55Nu-QB-XyN-qQ&oe=6726232A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=W5U151q-yGAQ7kNvgElfwZd&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCvdmNw5iOfA3tLr6xT_q1_anJB8y8HZFBZVSHNcI4z6A&oe=6725FE97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Fo6-WZi1jD8Q7kNvgHTCHK5&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBuXc5uAk13zWMTeLeW_S8lcKv1t8S7kHnfFr6dQ8g6Iw&oe=67261A0C)
